name: Stack
description: Draggable stack of cards where the top card can be flung, flicked, clicked or auto-advanced to the back with spring physics. Offers four stack layouts: fan, cascade, deck and pile.
contents: Stack of cards, each any React node, defaulting to 4 sample images
Optional frame border around each card and depth shading on lower cards
behavior: Top card is draggable with 3D tilt following drag velocity
Dragging past the threshold distance or flicking sends the top card flying out and back to the bottom of the stack
Lower cards lift forward as the top card is dragged
Optional click to send the top card to the back and optional autoplay with pause on hover
Keyboard: Arrow Right, Arrow Down, Enter or Space sends the top card to the back
Reduced motion preference replaces springs with short fades and skips tilt and fling
onChange fires with the index of the new top card
editableByProps: Card content and count, layout, number of visible cards
Spread, depth scaling, corner radius, frame width and color, shadow
Tilt amount, drag threshold, animation speed
Click to advance, autoplay, delay and pause on hover
Root size and position through className and style

needsCodeEdit.change: Change exit direction of the sent card per layout
Change card positions for a layout
Change accessibility label or keyboard keys
needsCodeEdit.where: aria-label on the root div and onKeyDown function

fixed: Root is w-full h-full, so the parent must give it a width and height or it collapses
Cards fill the root, so card size equals root size and cards should be sized through the parent or className
Only the top card can be dragged, other cards ignore pointer drag
Listens to window pointermove, pointerup and pointercancel while dragging, removed on release and unmount
Root is focusable with tabIndex 0 for keyboard use
Unknown layout value falls back to fan
Default sample images load from Unsplash URLs
Touch dragging uses touch-action pan-y on the top card, so vertical page scroll still works

options.look: Cards pivot from the bottom right corner and fan out with slight rotation and shrinking scale
options.useWhen: A hero or showcase beside text needs a playful hand-of-cards photo stack

options.look: Cards offset diagonally up and left behind the top card, each slightly smaller
options.useWhen: A portfolio or product preview needs a neat layered pile suggesting more items behind

options.look: Cards stacked straight up with a vertical offset like a deck, top card sends down
options.useWhen: A testimonials or stories widget needs a tidy vertical deck to swipe through

options.look: Cards scattered with random offsets and rotations like a casual pile of photos
options.useWhen: A gallery or travel memories section wants a casual scattered photo pile
